horrible.en: But the second one – oh, it's horrible! I felt quite stressed out actually.
horrible.zh: 但第二段——哦，太可怕了！其实我感到压力挺大的。

horrible.en: It was horrible. In this podcast, we're going to hear from some experts about why we itch and how scratching can be good for us.
horrible.zh: 太难受了。在这期播客中，我们将听几位专家讲讲，我们为什么会感到痒，以及挠痒对我们来说为什么其实是件好事。

horrible.en: I’m Neil. And I’m Beth. We all know how horrible it feels to be thirsty.
horrible.zh: 我是尼尔。我是贝丝。我们都知道口渴的感觉有多糟糕。

host.en: Host of BBC World Service's The Climate Question, Sophie Eastaugh, wanted to know more.
host.zh: BBC 世界服务频道《The Climate Question》节目主持人 Sophie Eastaugh 想进一步了解。

host.en: They used to host mock battles, executions, and dramatic performances inside the Colosseum.
host.zh: 他们过去常常在斗兽场内举办模拟海战、处决和戏剧表演。

host.en: And the city hosted royal ceremonies, diplomatic events if other countries’ leaders came to visit.
host.zh: 这座城市还举办了皇家典礼，以及其他国家领导人来访时的外交活动。

host.en: If I stopped hosting my conversation clubs, you probably wouldn’t want to pay me anymore.
host.zh: 如果我停止举办对话俱乐部，你可能就不想再付钱给我了。

host.en: But don't worry, says professional organiser and host of The Declutter Club podcast, Ingrid Jansen.
host.zh: 但别担心，专业整理师兼《断舍离俱乐部》播客主持人英格丽德·詹森说。

household.en: So, you're a family man, Neil. Do you do your fair share of household chores?
household.zh: 所以，尼尔，你是个顾家的男人。你承担了你那份公平的家务吗？

household.en: For example, imagine someone who grew up in a bilingual household.
household.zh: 例如，想象一个在双语家庭中长大的人。

household.en: And in the same report, household size is positively correlated with happiness, up to a point at least.
household.zh: 在同一份报告中，家庭规模与幸福感呈正相关，至少在一定程度上是这样。

household.en: His household is terrified. Charlotte, his wife, is terrified.
household.zh: 他的家人们惊恐万分。他的妻子夏洛特惊恐万分。

household.en: And finally, a multigenerational household is when people from two or more generations of the same family live together.
household.zh: 最后，多代同堂家庭是指同一个家庭的两代或更多代人生活在一起。

hopeful.en: If all this sounds a bit depressing. Kate's final message is more hopeful.
hopeful.zh: 如果所有这些听起来有点让人沮丧，Kate的最后传达的信息则更有希望。

hopeful.en: People with a positive attitude feel hopeful, confident, and focused on the good things in life.
hopeful.zh: 心态积极的人感到充满希望、自信，并专注于生活中的美好事物。

hopeful.en: Micro- retirement is one of the more hopeful and positive entries on Collins Word of the Year shortlist.
hopeful.zh: 微退休是柯林斯年度词汇短名单中比较充满希望和积极意义的词条之一。

hopeful.en: One important factor in ageing well is a positive attitude - feeling hopeful, confident, and focused on the good things in life.
hopeful.zh: 健康衰老的一个重要因素是积极的心态——感到充满希望、自信并专注于生活中的美好事物。

hostile.en: It was long, and the route was filled with bandits and hostile forces.
hostile.zh: 路途遥远，沿途布满了强盗和敌对势力。

hostile.en: Others suspect they ran afoul of a hostile tribe.
hostile.zh: 另一些人则怀疑他们撞上了敌对的部落。

hostile.en: Undeterred by this incredibly hostile territory, he would calmly record latitudes and longitudes in areas where few outsiders had ever ventured.
hostile.zh: 在这片极其恶劣的土地上，他毫不气馁，在极少有外来者涉足的地区冷静地记录着经纬度。

hostile.en: For the first six weeks after his arrest, the only statement they released about him was that he had committed "a hostile act against the state".
hostile.zh: 在他被捕后的头六周里，朝鲜官方就他发布的唯一一份声明，是说他犯下了"敌视国家的行为"。

hostile.en: Emails that are hostile in tone and language, or even cc'ing senior personnel in on the message in order to elevate an issue and put someone in their place.
hostile.zh: 语气和语言充满敌意的邮件，或者甚至在邮件中抄送高层人员来升级问题并给某人一点颜色看看。

horn.en: Yes, whether it's the rattle of train tracks, honking car horns, or the roar of aeroplanes overhead, modern cities are full of noise and this can have serious effects.
horn.zh: 是的，无论是铁轨的咣当声、汽车的按喇叭声，还是头顶飞机轰鸣声，现代城市都充满了噪音，这会产生严重的影响。

honour.en: In theory, it’s a day where the Egyptian people remember and honour the police.
honour.zh: 从理论上讲，这是埃及人民缅怀和纪念警察的日子。

honour.en: They didn’t fight for loyalty, honour, or patriotism—they fought for money.
honour.zh: 他们不为忠诚、荣誉或爱国主义而战——他们为钱而战。

honour.en: He graduated in 2009 with the highest honours, with a degree in political science and philosophy.
honour.zh: 他在2009年以最高荣誉毕业，获得了政治学和哲学学位。

honour.en: He refused a knighthood, turned down honours, and withdrew from public life.
honour.zh: 他拒绝了爵位，谢绝了荣誉，并退出了公众生活。

honour.en: And finally, the adjective honorific means showing respect and honour to someone.
honour.zh: 最后，形容词“honorific”（尊称的）意味着对某人表现出尊重和荣誉。

hook.en: I am fairly confident that it is b) – food put on a hook.
hook.zh: 我相当确信答案是 b）——放在钩子上的食物。

hook.en: In other words, he, and the North Koreans, were off the hook.
hook.zh: 换句话说，金正恩本人，还有整个朝鲜，都算是脱了身。

hook.en: As the authorities hoped, the phones started ringing off the hook.
hook.zh: 正如当局所期望的那样，电话开始响个不停。

hook.en: He was a Neapolitan invention, and he had a hooked nose and a hump on his back.
hook.zh: 他是那不勒斯人的创造，有着鹰钩鼻和驼背。

hook.en: His hair had been shaved off, he was hooked up with tubes, he was blind and deaf.
hook.zh: 他的头发被剃光了，身上插满了各种管子，双目失明，双耳失聪。

horizon.en: Danielle says they broadened their horizons, they investigated something in a new way to increase their knowledge and understanding of it.
horizon.zh: Danielle 说他们拓宽了视野(broadened their horizons)，也就是用一种新方式去研究某件事，从而增进对它的了解和认识。

horizon.en: We are broadening our horizons and studying people of Asian and African ancestry, and that has really opened up the knowledge that people are much more diverse than we ever realised…
horizon.zh: 现在我们正在拓宽视野，研究亚洲和非洲血统的人群，这让我们真正认识到，人类的多样性远比我们以往所了解的要丰富得多……

hole.en: If you spend too much time down internet rabbit holes, you’ll find accusations of the Freemasons’ involvement in historical events like the drafting of the U.S.
hole.zh: 如果你花太多时间泡在互联网的阴暗角落里，你会发现对共济会参与历史事件的种种指控，比如起草美国宪法。

hole.en: They were on topics I now realise were pretty difficult to make interesting in an audio-only format: there was one on how black holes work, and another one on how the international bond market works.
hole.zh: 它们的主题我现在意识到很难仅通过音频形式讲得有趣：有一期是关于黑洞如何运作的，另一期是关于国际债券市场如何运作的。

hole.en: And an extra little fun fact about Samuel Pepys is that he wrote one of the most detailed accounts of the Great Fire of London, which happened in 1666, and as the flames approached his house, he dug a big hole to protect his most prized possessions, the first of which was his parmesan cheese.
hole.zh: 关于 Samuel Pepys 还有一个有趣的冷知识，那就是他写下了关于 1666 年伦敦大火最详尽的记录之一。当大火逼近他的房子时，他挖了一个大坑来保护他最珍贵的财产，而排在第一位的竟然是他的帕玛森奶酪。

horizontal.en: Everyone knew the horizontal model of succession couldn’t last forever.
horizontal.zh: 大家都知道，水平继承的模式不可能永远持续下去。

horizontal.en: Power was officially moving vertically —from father to son— shattering the seven-decade-old tradition of horizontal, brother-to-brother succession.
horizontal.zh: 权力正式开始垂直过渡——从父亲传给儿子，粉碎了持续了七十年的兄弟之间水平继承的传统。

hospitality.en: There has been a boom in vocational courses, courses that teach students practical skills and prepare them for a particular job or career: hospitality management, journalism, and so on.
hospitality.zh: 职业课程出现了蓬勃发展，这些课程向学生传授实用技能，并为他们从事特定的工作或职业做好准备：酒店管理、新闻学等等。

honeymoon.en: From that point on, the honeymoon period of Caligula’s reign was well and truly over.
honeymoon.zh: 从那时起，Caligula 统治的蜜月期彻底结束了。

horror.en: So did Britain, and so did, shock horror, the West’s archenemy the Soviet Union.
horror.zh: 英国也有，而且令人大惊失色的是，西方死敌苏联也有。

horror.en: And we have a bunch of other “horror”-themed episodes, or ones about “weird history” too.
horror.zh: 我们还有一堆其他以“恐怖”为主题的节目，或者关于“猎奇历史”的节目。

horror.en: The horrors he witnessed there changed him forever.
horror.zh: 他在那里亲眼目睹的人间地狱彻底改变了他。

horror.en: He was only 30 years old. Now, when this sentence was announced, it was greeted with a mixture of horror and praise.
horror.zh: 当时他只有 30 岁。当这一判决公布时，人们的反应喜忧参半，既有震惊也有赞许。

horror.en: World leaders had just experienced the horrors of World War II, and they wanted to design a system that could prevent another global conflict.
horror.zh: 世界各国领导人刚刚经历第二次世界大战的恐怖，他们希望设计一个能够防止另一场全球冲突的系统。

holy.en: It was first created for religious reasons, to protect Christian pilgrims travelling to the Holy Land.
holy.zh: 它最初是为了宗教原因而创建的，旨在保护前往圣地的基督教朝圣者。

holy.en: So they sailed across the Atlantic, dreaming of a holy community, a shining “city upon a hill”.
holy.zh: 于是他们扬帆起航跨越大西洋，怀揣着建立一个圣洁社群、打造一座闪耀的“山巅之城”的梦想。

holy.en: Christian armies had managed to capture Jerusalem in 1099, and thousands of European pilgrims were inspired to make the journey to the Holy Land.
holy.zh: 基督教军队于1099年成功攻占了耶路撒冷，成千上万的欧洲朝圣者受到启发，踏上了前往圣地的旅程。

holy.en: The man at the centre of this idea was Sharif Hussein of Mecca, the ruler of the Hejaz, a region that included the two holiest cities in Islam—Mecca and Medina.
holy.zh: 这一构想的核心人物是麦卡的 Sharif Hussein，他是汉志地区的统治者，该地区包括伊斯兰教最神圣的两座城市——麦加和麦地那。

howl.en: Every creak of the floorboards, every howl of the wind through the frozen trees, felt like a sign.
howl.zh: 地板的每一次吱呀作响，风吹过冰冻树林时的每一次呼啸，都感觉像是一种征兆。

hostage.en: Moctezuma was taken hostage and violence broke out in the city.
hostage.zh: 蒙特苏马被劫为人质，城内随即爆发了暴力冲突。
